stem: A room becomes harder to control after canopy density increases and irrigation timing changes, even though HVAC setpoints did not change. Which explanation should be evaluated?
choices: Plant transpiration, irrigation events, lighting heat, crop density, and control sequencing may have changed sensible and latent loads even with unchanged setpoints.
The HVAC load must be unchanged because the setpoints are unchanged.
Only outdoor weather can change room moisture load.
Crop density affects yield but not environmental load.
rationale: Crop water release, lighting, irrigation, density, and control timing all influence sensible and latent loads; fixed setpoints do not imply fixed loads.
